question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the word: Mendacious
solution:
The correct answer is: **Honest**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"mendacious"** means someone who is not telling the truth; lying or deceitful. (झूठा/कपटी)

 
 
• **Example:** The witness gave a mendacious account of what happened at the scene.
 
 
 
• **"Honest"** refers to someone or something that is truthful and does not lie, cheat, or steal. (ईमानदार)
 
 
• **Example:** Everyone trusts Rohan because he is an honest person.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the antonym of **'mendacious'** is **'honest'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Honest**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **False** (झूठा): Not according with truth or fact; incorrect.

 
 
• **Example:** The statement he made in court was completely false.
 
 
 
• **Misleading** (भ्रामक): Giving the wrong idea or impression.
 
 
• **Example:** The advertisement was misleading and confused many customers.
 
 
 
• **Dishonourable** (अपमानजनक/बेईमान): Bringing shame or disgrace.
 
 
• **Example:** Cheating in the competition was a dishonourable act.
